prompt: The vet receptionist called to (say / tell) us that our golden retriever woke up fine after his dental check.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу указывается адресат (tell us that...), тогда как say требует предлога to перед адресатом.

prompt: A printed notice taped to the elevator door (says / tells) that the building water supply will be shut off tomorrow morning.
explanation_ru: О письменных текстах, объявлениях и вывесках без прямого дополнения-адресата используется глагол say (the notice says that...).

prompt: While rolling out the pastry dough, my grandfather finally (said / told) me his old family secret for keeping apple pie crust crispy.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое сочетание tell someone a secret требует глагола tell с прямым указанием собеседника.

prompt: With his mother waiting strictly by the shop door, the nervous teenager handed back the chocolate bar and (said / told) he was sorry.
explanation_ru: Фраза say (that) someone is sorry употребляется без прямого дополнения-адресата сразу после глагола.

prompt: Excited at three in the morning, the astronomer called her team and (said / told) that she had spotted a bright new comet on the screen.
explanation_ru: После глагола нет указания на слушателя перед союзом that, поэтому используется форма said (said that...).

prompt: She phoned her mother in disbelief to (say / tell) her that a pigeon had built a nest inside her drying laundry basket.
explanation_ru: Конструкция tell someone that требует прямого дополнения (her) сразу после глагола.

prompt: As soon as one colleague (said / told) everyone that the new sandwich shop downstairs gives free coffee on Fridays, the whole office rushed out.
explanation_ru: Сразу за глаголом стоит адресат сообщения (everyone), поэтому грамматически верен глагол told.

prompt: Beaming with joy, the customer walked up to the counter, (said / told) she had just gotten engaged, and ordered twenty chocolate pastries for her office.
explanation_ru: В придаточном предложении без прямого дополнения-адресата используется глагол said.

prompt: The woman leaned over to her husband and whispered that the receptionist had just (said / told) the doctor was running forty minutes late.
explanation_ru: Здесь the doctor — подлежащее придаточного предложения, а не адресат речи, поэтому нужен глагол said.

prompt: Before the museum opened, the junior assistant nervously (said / told) the curator that she had dropped a replica sword and hidden it behind the postcards.
explanation_ru: После глагола указан конкретный слушатель (the curator), что требует использования глагола told.

prompt: When the backpacker's labelled cheese vanished from the fridge, the hostel manager gathered everyone in the kitchen and asked who could (say / tell) him who had eaten it.
explanation_ru: В конструкции tell someone who... после глагола следует косвенное дополнение (him), поэтому выбираем tell.

prompt: Right after walking out of his final interview, he called his mother to (say / tell) that they had offered him the job on the spot.
explanation_ru: Поскольку адресат не повторен сразу после глагола перед that, используется глагол say.

prompt: The café owner called the local painter right after lunch to (say / tell) her some wonderful news. He (said / told) that three of her landscapes had sold within an hour of hanging on his wall. When she heard that, she could barely (say / tell) a word.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске есть адресат (tell her news), во втором адресата после глагола нет (said that), в третьем — устойчивое выражение say a word.

prompt: In the middle of practice, the choir director raised his hands and (said / told) everyone to stop singing. He smiled and (said / told) that the group had been invited to perform on local radio next month. Then he (said / told) us we needed two extra rehearsals before the broadcast.
explanation_ru: Конструкции tell someone to do и tell someone (that) требуют глагола told с адресатом, а без адресата перед that используется said.

prompt: After class, Leo pulled his best friend aside and (said / told) him the real reason he had missed yesterday's math test. He (said / told) he had overslept after studying until four in the morning. Before walking away, Leo begged his friend not to (say / tell) a soul.
explanation_ru: Сначала идет tell someone the reason, затем said без адресата, и в конце устойчивая фраза not to tell a soul (никому не рассказывать).

prompt: A volunteer found an intact Roman coin near the lunch tent and immediately (said / told) the site leader. The leader thanked him and (said / told) the whole crew that every find had to be logged before moving it. She also (said / told) that skipping the paperwork could ruin the dig's records.
explanation_ru: В первых двух пропусках после глагола указаны слушатели (the site leader, the whole crew), а в третьем стоит сразу союз that, поэтому нужен глагол said.

prompt: The potter sent a quick message to (say / tell) the buyer that the handmade ceramic mug was finally back in stock. She (said / told) only four mugs had come out of the kiln this week. She also (said / told) him to place his order soon before they sold out again.
explanation_ru: В первом и третьем случаях есть прямое дополнение-адресат (the buyer, him), во втором — придаточное предложение без адресата (said).

prompt: Looking embarrassed, the swimmer walked up to the lifeguard and (said / told) he had accidentally dropped his locker key down the shower drain. The lifeguard smiled and (said / told) him not to worry. He (said / told) the maintenance staff had a magnetic tool for situations just like this.
explanation_ru: Глагол told используется в конструкции tell him not to worry с адресатом, а said — перед придаточными предложениями без указания слушателя.

prompt: When a long line formed outside the bakery, the student showed the baker his phone and ___ that his video of the croissants had reached fifty thousand views overnight.
explanation_ru: Перед придаточным предложением с that без прямого дополнения-адресата используется глагол said.

prompt: She knocked on her neighbor's door to ___ she had scratched his parked bumper with her bicycle handlebar and offered to pay for the paint.
explanation_ru: В данном пропуске после глагола нет адресата (сразу идет придаточное she had scratched...), поэтому грамматически подходит только say (вариант 1 — say).

prompt: Standing on the empty platform, she phoned her colleague and ___ that she had missed the express train by just ten seconds.
explanation_ru: Поскольку адресат не указан сразу после глагола перед союзом that, правильный вариант — said.

prompt: On the first day of exams, the confused student ___ his professor that he had entered the wrong course code and studied German poetry instead of biology.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу ставится адресат без предлога (told his professor that...).

prompt: After the hailstorm dented several parked cars, one neighbor admitted he had forgotten to say everyone about the severe weather alert.
answer: After the hailstorm dented several parked cars, one neighbor admitted he had forgotten to tell everyone about the severe weather alert.
accepted_answers: After the hailstorm dented several parked cars, one neighbor admitted he had forgotten to tell everyone about the severe weather alert.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «сообщить кому-то о чём-то» используется глагол tell, а не say: tell everyone about...

prompt: During the morning stand-up meeting, the team leader told that everyone could take Friday afternoon off.
answer: During the morning stand-up meeting, the team leader said that everyone could take Friday afternoon off.
accepted_answers: During the morning stand-up meeting, the team leader said that everyone could take Friday afternoon off.
During the morning stand-up meeting, the team leader told us that everyone could take Friday afternoon off.
During the morning stand-up meeting, the team leader told the team that everyone could take Friday afternoon off.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell нельзя ставить сразу перед that без указания слушателя; если адресат не назван, используется said.

prompt: When the cat refused its normal dinner, one roommate confessed and told that she had given it extra treats earlier.
answer: When the cat refused its normal dinner, one roommate confessed and said that she had given it extra treats earlier.
accepted_answers: When the cat refused its normal dinner, one roommate confessed and said that she had given it extra treats earlier.
explanation_ru: Перед придаточным предложением с that без прямого дополнения-адресата нужен глагол said, а не told.

prompt: While trimming my hair, the stylist told me an exciting rumor about a new sourdough bakery opening in the old post office building.
answer: While trimming my hair, the stylist told me an exciting rumor about a new sourdough bakery opening in the old post office building.
accepted_answers: While trimming my hair, the stylist told me an exciting rumor about a new sourdough bakery opening in the old post office building.
explanation_ru: Предложение составлено верно: глагол told употреблен с прямым дополнением-адресатом (told me an exciting rumor).

prompt: Dark smoke starts pouring out of the kitchen oven, and the husband admits he forgot to set the timer for the garlic bread.
options: He told his wife he had forgotten to set the timer for the garlic bread.
He said his wife he had forgotten to set the timer for the garlic bread.
He told that he had forgotten to set the timer for the garlic bread.
He said to his wife that he had forgotten setting the timer for the garlic bread.
explanation_ru: Конструкция tell someone (that)... требует глагола told с прямым дополнением his wife без предлога to.

prompt: A brief evening news update announces that a missing antique clock from the town hall was found safe in an empty garage.
options: The newsreader told that the missing antique clock had been found safe in an empty garage.
The newsreader said the missing antique clock had been found safe in an empty garage.
The newsreader said viewers the missing antique clock had been found safe in an empty garage.
The newsreader told to viewers that the missing antique clock had been found safe in an empty garage.
explanation_ru: Когда адресат речи не указан сразу после глагола, перед придаточным предложением используется глагол said.

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'told' instead of 'said to': She said to her friends that a bright green solar storm was heading toward the island tonight.
answer: She told her friends that a bright green solar storm was heading toward the island tonight.
accepted_answers: She told her friends that a bright green solar storm was heading toward the island tonight.
She told her friends a bright green solar storm was heading toward the island tonight.
explanation_ru: Конструкция say to someone заменяется на tell someone без предлога to перед дополнением.
